metaTitle: Rental agreement, handover protocol and house rules templates
metaDescription: Free templates for renting a room or flat in Bulgaria: a rental agreement, a handover protocol and house rules. Fill in, print and sign.
title: Rental templates
intro: Free templates to fill in, print and sign with the other side. Read them carefully and adapt them to your situation.
disclaimer: These templates are a starting point, not legal advice. For a large amount, a long term or unusual conditions, ask a lawyer. Stay.bg is not a party to the agreement.
versionNote: If you can, sign the Bulgarian version (switch the language at the top) or a bilingual copy. This English version helps both sides understand it.
printHint: Choose “Save as PDF” in the print dialog if you want a file.

lease.title: Rental agreement
lease.summary: For a room or a whole flat: parties, term, rent, deposit, bills, obligations and termination.
lease.metaDescription: Free rental agreement template for a room or flat in Bulgaria: rent, deposit, bills, term and termination. Fill in and print.
lease.preamble: Today, ______, in ______, the parties below entered into this rental agreement.

clauses.property: The landlord lets to the tenant, for temporary use against payment, ______________ (a room / the whole flat) at ______________, street / estate ______________ no. ____, entrance ____, floor ____, flat ____.
clauses.common: The tenant may also use the shared parts of the home: ______________________ (kitchen, bathroom, living room, balcony, etc.).
clauses.ownership: The landlord declares that they own the property or are entitled to let it under ______________________ (title deed / power of attorney / the owner’s consent).
clauses.condition: The property is handed over with the furniture and in the condition described in the handover protocol, which forms part of this agreement.

clauses.length: This agreement is for ____ months, from ______________ to ______________.
clauses.extension: If the tenant keeps using the property after the term ends, with the landlord’s knowledge and without objection, the agreement continues for an indefinite term.

clauses.amount: The monthly rent is ______________ EUR, payable by the ____ day of each month.
clauses.method: Rent is paid by bank transfer to IBAN ______________________ in the name of ______________________, or in cash against a signed receipt.
clauses.utilities: Electricity, water, heating, internet and the building fee ______________________ (are included in the rent / are paid by the tenant according to the meters / are split as follows: ______________).
clauses.change: The rent can only be changed by a written agreement between the parties.

clauses.amount: On signing, the tenant pays a deposit of ______________ EUR, for which the landlord issues a receipt.
clauses.return: The deposit is returned within ____ days of the property being vacated, less unpaid rent and bills and the cost of damage beyond normal wear and tear recorded in the handover protocol.
clauses.lastMonth: The deposit is not used to pay the last month’s rent unless the parties agree to this in writing.

clauses.handover: To hand over the property fit to live in and to ensure its undisturbed use for the whole term.
clauses.repairs: To pay for repairs and damage not caused by ordinary use or by the tenant’s fault.
clauses.visits: To visit the property only by prior arrangement with the tenant, except in an emergency.

clauses.pay: To pay the rent and bills on time.
clauses.care: To use the property with care and for its purpose, and to follow the house rules and the rules of the building.
clauses.minor: To pay for minor repairs arising from ordinary use.
clauses.sublet: Not to sublet all or part of the property or move anyone in permanently without the landlord’s written consent.
clauses.notify: To tell the landlord straight away about any damage or emergency.
clauses.return: On leaving, to return the property in the condition it was received, allowing for normal wear and tear.

clauses.expiry: The agreement ends when the term expires or by mutual written agreement.
clauses.notice: Either party may end the agreement with ____ days’ written notice (at least 30).
clauses.default: The landlord may end the agreement without notice if the tenant is more than ____ days late with the rent.
clauses.protocol: On termination, the parties sign a handover protocol for the return of the property and settle the deposit.

clauses.changes: Changes to this agreement are valid only in writing and signed by both parties.
clauses.law: Matters not covered here are governed by the Bulgarian Obligations and Contracts Act.
clauses.copies: This agreement is made and signed in two identical copies, one for each party.

handover.title: Handover protocol
handover.summary: Signed on moving in and on moving out: meter readings, keys, furniture and the condition of the property.
handover.metaDescription: Free handover protocol template for a rental in Bulgaria: meter readings, keys, furniture and notes on the condition of the property.
handover.preamble: Attached to the rental agreement of ______________. Today, ______________, the parties signed this protocol on ______________ (moving in / moving out).

notes.title: Notes and damage
notes.writeIn: Describe any damage, anything missing and anything that does not work. Photos taken today are attached to this protocol.

houseRules.title: House rules
houseRules.summary: For flatmates: quiet hours, cleaning, guests, shared bills, smoking and pets.
houseRules.metaDescription: Free house rules template for flatmates: quiet hours, a cleaning rota, guests and shared bills.
houseRules.preamble: House rules for ______________________, agreed on ______________ by everyone who lives here.

clauses.hours: Quiet hours: from ____ to ____ on weekdays and from ____ to ____ at weekends.
clauses.volume: Music, TV and phone calls in shared spaces are kept at a moderate volume.

clauses.rota: Shared spaces (kitchen, bathroom, hallway) are cleaned on a rota: ______________________.
clauses.dishes: Dishes are washed within ____ hours of use.

clauses.overnight: Overnight guests: up to ____ nights a week, after letting the others know.
clauses.partners: A partner who stays permanently moves in only with everyone’s agreement and the landlord’s.

clauses.split: Electricity, water, heating and internet are split ______________ (equally / by use) and paid by the ____ of each month to ______________.
clauses.supplies: Shared supplies (cleaning products, toilet paper, etc.) are bought ______________ (from a shared fund of ____ EUR a month / in turns).

clauses.shelves: Everyone has their own shelf in the fridge and cupboard; ask before taking someone else’s food.
clauses.clean: The hob, microwave and sink are cleaned straight after use.

clauses.smoking: Smoking is ______________ (not allowed in the flat / allowed on the balcony only).

clauses.door: The front door is always locked; keys are never given to anyone else.
clauses.energy: Windows are not left open with the heating on; appliances are switched off when you go out.

clauses.talk: Problems are raised directly and early. If we cannot agree, ______________________.
clauses.leaving: Anyone moving out tells the others ____ days in advance.
